title: Avesta's island continent that froze over

tellings.quote: So in the Avesta it says that the the you know Arian the Aryan people uh come from an island continent at the center of the world which froze over

plain: The Avesta, the ancient holy scripture of the old Iranian religion of Zoroastrianism, says the Aryan people came from an island continent at the centre of the world that froze over. The researcher Jason Jorjani tells Michels this from his own reading, without naming a further source, and the story links Iran with Antarctica. If true, it would mean an ancient text remembers a homeland lost under ice.
